verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents free custom email on your own domain. It also offers SSL certificates (DV, 256-bit), but the evidence never says SSL is free or bundled, so the zero-cost launch path is only half shown. missing for 10: explicit email forwarding documentation, evidence that SSL is free or bundled with the domain, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the basics are bundled — email forwarding on my domain and free SSL so the parked-to-launched path costs nothing extra

citations.quote: Start your free custom email using your own domain and strengthen your brand identity with Dynadot Email.
Secure your site with trusted 256-bit encryption. Get fast DV (Domain Validation), approval
